title: Ultrahuman science scatter
description: A window-tall white section with a centred intro (title, grey line, dark pill) ringed by six rounded photo tiles: two overlapping pairs and two singles near the corners, bleeding off the edges on phones. As the section scrolls in, the tiles fly out from the middle to their spots and grow from 60% to full size while the intro rises in.
notes: CSS scroll-driven (view timeline on the section); without support or with reduced motion the tiles sit in place
the tile layout is fixed at six slots
name: ultrahuman-science

props.name: photos
props.description:
six photos for the tiles around the copy, in this order: top-left back, top-left front,
top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right back, bottom-right front. Placeholders fill gaps.
